name: Iori
message: 「Everyone, we’ve arrived at the yakiniku restaurant just like we promised！」

name: Setsugekka & Ririmu
message: 「Yaaaaaay！」

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, you guys are high energy.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You gotta have high energy to eat yakiniku, right！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「To-day i-is, the hap-py meat day~♪」
It seems there are two carnivores in the group. I’m glad they’re happy, at least.

name: Iori
message: 「By the way… I was the one who picked the place, but is that okay with everyone？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Totally okay! I mean, the place Sensei booked has a reputation for being super delicious!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ho-ho, I’m looking forward to that then.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Excuse me, staff member♪ We’re going to eat every single piece of meat in this restaurant today~♪」

name: Iori
message: 「Save that for when we—no, don’t even say that once we’re inside.」
Everyone looks like they’re having fun, so I guess I chose a good spot.
Well then, before we get obsessed with the meat, just one thing—

name: Iori
message: 「Everyone, good job on the exams. Don’t hold back and eat as much as you want today！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Okay~♪ I’m even gonna eat the plates！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Please don’t really eat them, you’ll get a stomach ache.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Feeling hyped！ I think it’s okay to disable the calorie limit for today, right~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Thanks for the treat.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Iori-sensei is in harem mode again.」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, Asahi？」
For some reason, Asahi had a dissatisfied look on her face. Come to think of it, she hadn’t even joined in on the conversation.

name: Iori
message: 「Is something wrong？ You don’t seem to be in a very good mood...」

name: Asahi
message: 「No, it’s nothing. Please, don’t mind me.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Sensei, what are you doing！ Hurry up, hurry up！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If we don’t hurry, all the rare cuts of meat will be gone~！」

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, hey...！」
As I was worrying about Asahi, Ririmu and the others suddenly grabbed my arm tight.
And then, without stopping, they started pulling me along.

name: Iori
message: 「I, I think she’ll be fine, though……！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Fufu, we have a reservation time to keep, so let's get going right away.」
As if urged on by everyone, we headed toward the restaurant.

name: Staff
message: 「Thank you for waiting♪ Here are 10 servings of our special kalbi and special loin.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It’s heeeere！！ It has arrived♪」
Once we arrived at the restaurant and the meat we ordered was brought out, Setsugekka’s excitement seemed to spark instantly.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Meat！ Come on, let's grill it, let's grill it right now！ And then let's eat！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Haa... I feel like I could just eat it raw at this point.」

name: Asahi
message: 「You'll get a stomachache. Besides, it's tastier when it's grilled.」
The others were also eyeing the mountain of meat with sparkling eyes.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「For now, let's just keep grilling！ Leave it to me, haaaaah…… Mishima-ryuu Cat Style, Thousand-Hand Sagesse！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, she's putting the meat on the grill with incredible speed！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Cat style...？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That's right！ A new secret Mishima-ryuu technique I came up with: Cat-chan Punch！ Nya-nya-nya-nya-nya-nya！」
Meowing all the while, she filled the grill with meat in the blink of an eye.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ahh, the smell of the meat grilling... it's just irresistible！ Well then... itadakimasu♪」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ham, amu... mmm~♪ Haa, it’s melting...♪ Something so gooey and hot... inside my mouth... haafu」

name: Asahi
message: 「...This is！ Yes, it’s delicious.」

name: Iori
message: 「Let's see... ooh, that’s good！」
And perhaps thanks to the cat, the grill was constantly fully occupied.

name: Ririmu
message: 「So delicious！ Just as you’d expect from the number one-rated spot. Hey, hey, pass me that moromi miso sauce over there~」

name: Iori
message: 「...Hmm. Well, it seems there’s no <d0083>Grilling Master</d> here.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「'Grilling Master'？ What are you talking about？」

name: Iori
message: 「You know, that type of person who gives detailed orders for everything, like how you should grill it and all that.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Is there anyone like that in the Tenju Special Forces？」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s how my captain is. But the captain always ends up getting the meat eaten while lecturing everyone on how to grill it.」

name: Iori
message: 「Everyone in my squad judges food by whether it’s edible, not whether it’s delicious.」

name: Asahi
message: 「That’s… that’s a little pitiful for your captain.」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, well, yakiniku really shows a person’s personality.」
For instance, Setsugekka is the type who pours her passion into filling up the grill. Thanks to her, any empty space is instantly filled.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「First, grab the meat！ Then, immediately put more meat on！ And eat while the rest is grilling！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「And the moment someone clears a spot on the grill, fill it right back up！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Setsugekka, if you put too much on, won't you fall behind on eating it？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It’s okay! If the overcooking alarm goes off, I’ll be sure to eat it all up!」
On the other hand, Keisetsu seems to take a slow pace with both grilling and eating. Though, it looks like she hasn’t managed to grab much meat.

name: Iori
message: 「Here, Keisetsu. This one’s ready.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Thank you. I’m sorry to have troubled you.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, no, don’t mention it. I’m the flexible type who supports everyone around me while I eat.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Type…？」

name: Iori
message: 「Anyway, just go ahead and eat. There’s still plenty left.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Fufu, don’t worry about me. I’ll eat at my own pace.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eehhh！？ If you’re too shy, you’ll never grow big and strong, you know？」

name: Momiji
message: 「How much more are you planning to grow, Secchan?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Let’s see… maybe like 57 meters tall~. Nom nom, oh, this is yummy…♪」

name: Iori
message: 「Are you trying to become a giant robot or something…？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Speaking of which, we passed by that brand shop earlier, didn’t we？ You know, the place where we picked out clothes the other day~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Clothes？ Oh, yeah, that’s the place where you helped me pick some out！」
—As Ririmu talks, pretending to be uninterested in the yakiniku, she deftly steals the meat off Setsugekka’s plate.
Ririmu is the type who’s quick to take the best parts for herself.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「H-hey！ That’s my meat！ I was keeping it there to save for later！ I won’t forgive a meat thief！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Eh? It’s fine, isn’t it? Oh, never mind that, look！ If you leave that over there, it’s gonna burn~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, you’re right！ Such a waste, such a waste！ *Nom*, *munch munch*... so good♪」

name: Ririmu
message: 「How’s yours？ Is it cooked？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Mine? Not quite yet, I think?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I see, not yet, huh? *Munch munch*」
Meanwhile, it seems there are others who prefer to take what they want through raw skill rather than strategy—

name: Momiji
message: （『Shingan no Kiwamete, activate... Target, loin at 74 degrees to the right. 6 seconds remaining until optimal doneness. Correction: plus two』）

name: Momiji
message: （“Error adjustment until chopsticks arrive: minus 0.4... There！”）

name: Momiji
message: 「...Mission complete. *Munch munch*, so good」
She snatches up the meat with speed faster than the eye can follow. She’s like a falcon.
She doesn't have an Origami on her, so there's no Tenju or anything of the sort, but she seems to be putting her trained intuition and technique to good use.
Though, much like Momiji, Asahi also seemed to be targeting meat using her own intuition and technique.

name: Momiji
message: 「Hah！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ngh... the meat in front of me just vanished...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yum yum」

name: Asahi
message: 「Then I’ll take that one—there！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hahaha, too slow」

name: Asahi
message: 「The one who’s slow is you！ My real target is this kalbi！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Guh...！ You’re pretty good...！ But I wanted the loin, so the damage is minimal...！」
What are they doing? Both of them.

name: Iori
message: 「You two look like you’re having fun, but keep it within a range that doesn’t get us banned」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, but more importantly, Teacher, haven't you barely eaten anything？ That’s no good！ Men need to eat more！」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh？ Oh, I’m fine. I’m eating」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Should I give you some of the ones I took？ Here, here, want me to go ‘aaaah’ for you？」

name: Iori
message: 「N-no, I’m fine, really」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah！ That’s cheating！ I want to try that too！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Then I’ll be the one to immediately shove a piece of meat into your mouth the moment you open it, Teacher」

name: Iori
message: 「That is no longer a simple ‘say ah’！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Fufu, it’s tough being a teacher, isn't it? By the way, I have some meat I can't finish, too…」
Slipping over, Keisetsu sidled up to me.

name: Iori
message: 「Don't say that while getting so close！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Teacher！ Eat mine too, eat mine！ Eat me！」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s taking on a whole different meaning！」
As we were exchanging words while I pushed back the meat being thrust at me from all directions—
Suddenly, I felt a gaze.
A very cold one, or perhaps hot... in any case, it was a sharp gaze.
I turned toward it—the source of the glare was Asahi.

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi？ Is something wrong？ Your eyes look scary…」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Eh~？ Isn’t that just normal for her？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, it looks like she’s actually angry about something.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I believe the fact that Iori-sensei is getting along so well with everyone is a very good thing.」

name: Asahi
message: 「However, aren't you all being a bit too clingy?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「See~, it’s just the usual jealousy, right?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Asahi-chan really does love Sensei so much, doesn't she~」

name: Asahi
message: 「Fufu, naturally.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Come to think of it, the other day when we were talking about Sensei, Asahi-chan gave me a photo of him, nom, chew…」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ah, me too, me too! I got one where he looks perfectly handsome~」

name: Iori
message: 「W-wait a minute, what does that mean？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Everyone seemed very interested in Iori-sensei, so I shared just a little bit of my collection.」

name: Iori
message: 「D-don’t tell me that’s…」
The ones from the private photoshoot where I was shirtless…?

name: Asahi
message: 「Don’t worry, those were photos of you wearing normal clothes.」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Hmm？ So that means there are some where you aren't wearing clothes？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ufufu, it’s a secret!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, I want that! Come on, Asahi-chan, gimme~!」

name: Asahi
message: 「No way, this shirtless photo is mine and mine alone」

name: Asahi
message: 「Sensei's bulging pecs were just so, so magnificent...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa~, hey Asahi, just a peek, let me see~!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ufufu, I wouldn't mind if you'd sign a written pledge yielding Iori-sensei to me」

name: Ririmu
message: 「S-Scary... A written pledge？！」

name: Iori
message: 「Stop transferring and claiming ownership of me without my permission!」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Complaints from Iori-sensei will not be accepted!」

name: Asahi
message: 「All of this is because you're so indecisive, Sensei」

name: Iori
message: 「I-It's my fault？！」

name: Asahi
message: 「You're kind to everyone, Iori-sensei, and I know better than anyone what a truly wonderful person you are」

name: Asahi
message: 「However, because you're far too kind to everyone, everyone's affection for you just keeps skyrocketing!」

name: Asahi
message: 「I also know that you're by no means dense, Iori-sensei」

name: Asahi
message: 「So there's no way you haven't noticed everyone's feelings for you」

name: Iori
message: 「W-Well... I guess...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Putting me aside, don't you think pretending not to notice their feelings is rather improper!」

name: Momiji
message: 「What's wrong with keeping quiet about it？」

name: Asahi
message: 「At this rate, it's going to turn into a harem!」

name: Iori
message: 「Hmm, I'm not really hoping for that, though. What would it take to satisfy you, Asahi?」

name: Asahi
message: 「It's simple—if you just state clearly who you like the most, Iori-sensei, everything will be settled」

name: Iori
message: 「Pffft？！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Well, Iori-sensei? Is there a girl you have your eye on among us?」

name: Iori
message: 「W-Well... you see...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whaaat, wait, there really is？！ Who is it—could it be me？！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, yeah, I'm seriously interested！ Come on Iori-rin, why don't you just confess everything right here?♪」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ooh~, this is getting interesting!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Come now, Iori-san! Give us a straight answer!」

name: Iori
message: 「Wait, wait, everyone just calm down!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「How could we possibly be calm right now?！ Teacher, don't you have something to say for yourself?！」

name: Momiji
message: 「We'd like a word about your hot romance with your special someone, please~」
What is this, a press conference？！

name: Iori
message: 「Ahem... Look, okay？ I'm everyone's teacher.」

name: Iori
message: 「As long as I'm a teacher, I have a duty to treat you all equally. Even if there were someone, I couldn't give them special treatment.」

name: Iori
message: 「So, can you understand that...? No?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Of course that's a no!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「There's no way we're buying that！」

name: Momiji
message: 「We reject your non-committal answer！」
Geez... well, I suppose that was bound to happen.

name: Iori
message: 「But look, I can't publicly declare anything, even if you draw your swords on me.」
If I were to say anything, it would have to be after graduation, when we're no longer 'teacher and student'...

name: Iori
message: 「However, I have no intention of building a harem, and in my own mind, my feelings aren't ambiguous.」

name: Iori
message: 「For now, I'd like you to please leave it at that.」

name: Momiji
message: 「So in other words, you *do* like someone in particular, don't ya~」
Momiji-san, could you not show off your deductive skills at a time like this...？

name: Asahi
message: 「I see... I can't say I'm satisfied, but for now, we shall sheath our blades with that answer.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then let's change the subject and get some meat！ Meat, meat~♪」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Eh~, you still wanna eat？ I'll come along, of course. Setsugekka, you really are a JGSDF Gorilla, aren't ya~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ehehe, if Teacher is going back, maybe I'll just tag along~♪」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ooh, an aggressive move right there.」

name: Asahi
message: 「It seems I'll have to settle things with you once and for all, Setsugekka-san...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ehehe... well, since Asahi-chan already announced it, I figured a little bit would be alright, maybe...♪」

name: Iori
message: 「But Setsugekka, while you're busy saying that, Momiji is...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Gotcha. Meat secured~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Aaaahhh?!? You took the best one!」
As I thought. She was targeting it with everything she had, after all.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Curse you, Suzakuin...！ Even if you are Momimomi, I won't forgive you for this！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Fuhahaha, very well. Come at me.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You jerk, don't think you can win against me with chopsticks！ Eat this, Mishima-ryuu Form of the Cleaver: Shadow, Flame Thrust！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmph, thinking you can beat Suzakuin with that level of speed? You're a hundred years too early！ Take that, take that~！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Cut it out with the metal chopsticks fighting！」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Mishima-ryuu is amazing, isn't it？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That's another one of Setsugekka's originals. I'm sure the Master will scold her.」
And with that—the fun time passed by in the blink of an eye.

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, that was good. Everyone, are you all satisfied？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yuuup, I can't eat another bite~♪」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, that's good. It ended up being cheaper than I thought, which is a huge help for me too.」

name: Asahi
message: 「No, I feel like it was quite an expensive amount...」

name: Iori
message: 「Even if we split the bill at the Tenju Special Forces, it costs double what it did today. I'm always the one getting the short end of the stick, hahaha.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Split the bill！？ What kind of girls are in the Tenju Special Forces！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Still, it was a good appetite. The Tenju Special Forces will always welcome you all.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes, sir~♪」

name: Momiji
message: 「Is it a requirement that only gluttons can become members...？」
Saying things like that, we all headed home.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh, my stomach hurts~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Don't you think you ate way too much, no matter how you look at it?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I wonder if this uniform could be a bit... looser? The way it cinches at the waist is just painful...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Uniforms, huh? You know, I’d love to design uniforms for Murakumo Academy in the future!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh really? What kind of design would you make?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Heh-heh, actually, I’ve already got it all planned out. Something cool that perfectly captures the Murakumo Academy vibe！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「First off, it’s all about the ribbon!」

name: Momiji
message: 「You mean wearing a ribbon on your head？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No way！ You know how kimonos have an obi？ I want to put a big one like that on the back of the waist~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「And then I want to scatter some flowers all over it, too. I mean, for a girl, those things are super important, right?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「And the skirt needs to be a bit flashier, with more frills, and I want the colors to be lighter than they are now!」
Ririmu explained using lots of gestures. Everyone listened intently, nodding along.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa, that sounds like it’s gonna be super cute！ I’d love to wear that~♪」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, I think it sounds good.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Right? Right? Maybe I should pitch it to the Flying Lily brand！」

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha, it’s good to have plenty of dreams.」
Surprisingly, she might actually make it happen.

name: Asahi
message: 「I’ve had a great idea. Let’s have Ririmu-san coordinate an outfit for Iori-san as well.」

name: Iori
message: 「...Huh？ Me？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s a great idea！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wait, I only do girls’ fashion, though？ But for Teach... hmm, yeah, maybe...」

name: Iori
message: 「Uh oh, she’s got that look in her eyes like she’s actually considering it... Anyway, we’re dismissed for today！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, Teach is running away！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Wait up! Is that any way for a teacher to act!?」

name: Asahi
message: 「That’s so unfair！」
Some chased after him, others looked on in disbelief. But everyone was smiling and clearly having a great time.
